tooltip.jaymospowers.tinkering.stone_anv: A rough anvil made by sneak-hammering stone. Nothing better than Well Forged, no steel, and it crumbles after 64 forgings.
tooltip.jaymospowers.tinkering.drafting_: Use it holding a blueprint, with paper in your pack, to copy the blueprint one level lower.
tooltip.jaymospowers.smithing.too_long_t: Too long to cast; hammer it on a Smithing Anvil
tooltip.jaymospowers.smithing.cast_grade: Copied from a %s head; heads poured from it are %s
Keep it in your inventory while you hammer; it caps your best grade. Without one, no better than Expertly Forged.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.quench_fir: Quench it first: dip the hot piece in water or a water cauldron.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.needs_iron: %s is too hard for this anvil. It needs an iron Smithing Anvil.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.needs_stee: %s is too hard for this hammer. It needs a steel Smithing Hammer.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.stone_anvi: The stone anvil is cracking apart.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.drafting_n: You need paper in your inventory to copy a blueprint.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.drafting_h: Hold a blueprint (with paper in your pack) to copy it.
